metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the jfdi-agents team. Adding this marketplace to Claude Code via `/plugin marketplace add <this-repo-url>` and then running `/plugin install jfdi-agents@jfdi-agents` installs the plugin to your chosen scope and removes the need to pass --plugin-dir on every session launch. See plugins/jfdi-agents/docs/local-install.md in the repo for the full walkthrough.

plugins.name: jfdi-agents
plugins.description: Architect-led agent team for autonomous software development. Product Owner + Architect design the system and mint per-layer developer agents (backend, frontend, middleware, shared) tailored to the chosen stack. The team walks the stack sequentially to build a walking skeleton, then parallelises refinement with each developer owning its own folder. Lightweight on documentation — vision, folder map, high-level acceptance list — and heavy on actually shipping code.
